description: The four hard-break categories of the viability rubric (07-R4, T-M4-09), moved out of skills/viability-assessment/SKILL.md so scripts/analysis/assess.sh counts them the same way on every run. A category is present when its POSIX ERE (case-sensitive, grep -E) matches at least one file of the subject whose name matches one of its globs. The matched files are listed; the count of categories present is the rubric's hard_breaks. The patterns are the 0.9 skill's, unchanged, so the verdict reproduces; each fact was verified against the drupal/core 11.4.8 tree of the lab bed.

entries.label: Twig 3 (removed filters/functions, spaceless)
entries.src: drupal/core 11.4.8 core/composer.json requires twig/twig ^3.28.0; twig 3.x ships no spaceless token parser (src/TokenParser), and its spaceless filter is deprecated since twig 3.12 (src/Extension/CoreExtension.php)

entries.label: CKEditor 5 (CKEditor 4 removed since Drupal 10)
entries.src: drupal/core 11.4.8 has core/modules/ckeditor5 and no core/modules/ckeditor

entries.label: jQuery UI (core/jquery.ui.* removed or externalized)
entries.src: drupal/core 11.4.8 core/core.libraries.yml declares no jquery.ui library; only internal.jquery_ui remains
